description: Find open-source AI projects across both Archestack lists by words and filters. Words match names, repos, taglines, categories and the products a project replaces; results rank by how many words match, then exact names, then projects whose name or category holds the words, then by score. Put hard needs in the filters, not the words (no_gpu instead of "without a GPU").

arm64.description: true: only projects with an arm64 build (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi, Graviton)

category.description: Only this category: id or title, e.g. "vector-db" or "Vector databases"

has_demo.description: true: only projects with a live demo

license.description: License family. permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD and similar. copyleft: GPL, AGPL, LGPL, MPL. custom: anything else, including no license

no_gpu.description: true: only projects that run without a GPU

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "vector database" or "chat ui ollama". Leave out to rank by score.

name: search_projects
title: Search projects
